items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: I think actually it was Wayman Carver.

ctx.x: Yeah. There seems to be a — let’s say historical confusion about who actually was the first, or at least flute player to appear on a jazz record. Some say it was Frank, I’ve heard Sam Most.
I think actually it was Wayman Carver.
Okay, that’s another name I’ve heard.
